name: Union Garage
note: Core (commuter) and faculty/staff permit parking during enforcement hours. Visitors pay with the ParkMobile app (zone 8001, $15 a day). From 11pm to 5am entry needs a TU OneCard with an active permit, at the after-hours entrance only.

name: Towsontown Garage
note: Core (commuter) and faculty/staff permit parking during enforcement hours. Visitors pay with the ParkMobile app (zone 8001, $15 a day). From 11pm to 5am entry needs a TU OneCard with an active permit, at the after-hours entrance only.

name: Glen Garage
note: Core (commuter) and faculty/staff permit parking during enforcement hours. Visitors pay with the ParkMobile app (zone 8001, $15 a day). From 11pm to 5am entry needs a TU OneCard with an active permit, at the after-hours entrance only.

name: West Village Garage
note: Levels 4 to 6 are for West Village resident permits at all times. Faculty/staff permits and visitors (ParkMobile zone 8002, $15 a day) use the other levels. From 11pm to 5am entry needs a TU OneCard with an active permit, at the after-hours entrance only.

name: Lot 1
note: Visitor lot at Enrollment Services. Pay with the ParkMobile app (zone 8006, $15 a day). Check the posted signs for evenings and weekends.

name: Lot 2
note: Millennium Hall permit holders only. Privately managed, and cars without that permit are towed.

name: Lot 3
note: Visitor parking near the Center for the Arts. Pay with the ParkMobile app (zone 8001, $15 a day). Check the posted signs for evenings and weekends.

name: Lot 4
note: Stadium overflow lot: any TU permit during enforcement hours. Visitors pay with the ParkMobile app (zone 8003, $15 a day). May be restricted on game days. Staying overnight needs a $15 ParkMobile overnight permit.

name: Lot 5
note: Stadium overflow lot: any TU permit during enforcement hours. May be restricted on game days. No overnight parking without an overnight permit.

name: Lot 6
note: Stadium lot. The permit type is not published, so check the posted signs. A game-day permit is required on football days.

name: Lot 7
note: Stadium overflow lot: any TU permit during enforcement hours, except the Landscape Services area. Visitors pay with ParkMobile (zone 8003, $15 a day). Football days need a game-day permit and the lot closes before kickoff. Overnight needs a $15 overnight permit.

name: Lot 8
note: Stadium overflow lot (part of the lot is excluded; follow the signs): any TU permit during enforcement hours. Visitors pay with ParkMobile (zone 8003, $15 a day). Football days need a game-day permit and the lot closes before kickoff. Overnight needs a $15 overnight permit.

name: Lot 8a
note: Stadium lot. The permit type is not published, so check the posted signs.

name: Lot 9
note: Visitor lot at the Administration Building. Pay with the ParkMobile app (zone 8001, $15 a day). Check the posted signs for evenings and weekends.

name: Lot 10
note: Faculty/staff permit lot behind the Administration Building. Check the posted signs for evenings and weekends.

name: Lot 11
note: Near the Glen towers. The permit type is not published, so check the posted signs.

name: Lot 12
note: Public Safety vehicles and permits only.

name: Lot 13
note: General Services permits, plus a few visitor spaces for people with business in the General Services or Public Safety buildings.

name: Lot 14
note: Visitor parking at the Health Center. Pay with the ParkMobile app (zone 8005, $15 a day). Check the posted signs for evenings and weekends.

name: Lot 16
note: The permit type is not published, so check the posted signs.

name: Lot 17
note: Accessible parking (state plate or placard plus a TU permit) and department guests only.
